title: VTA DIDs List — payload
description: Enumerate every identity a VTA holds that the caller may see, whatever its DID method or key assurance level, optionally narrowed. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

methods.description: Only identities of these methods, named as their profiles are (`webvh`, `scid:vh`, `webs`, `key`).

serverId.description: Only identities published through this hosting server.

class.description: Only identities created in this DID class.

includeDeactivated.description: Include identities that have been ended. Absent means no.

cursor.description: Opaque position from a previous response's `nextCursor`. The VTA accepts only a cursor it issued, for the same filters.

limit.description: The most identities to return. Absent lets the VTA choose.

dids.description: Matching identities the caller may see, one summary each. An empty array is a successful answer, and does not imply the VTA holds none.

nextCursor.description: Position of the next page. Absent on the last page.
